project_type: Local-only Kiro session-log viewer. npm workspaces monorepo: watcher/ (Node+TS, tails ~/.kiro/sessions messages.jsonl, serves WebSocket on 8787) and web/ (Vite+TS+Three.js isometric office UI on 5280). No UI framework; hand-rolled DOM via document.createElement + textContent.
build_system: npm workspaces at repo root. watcher runs via tsx (no emit build). web builds with `tsc && vite build`. No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering exist. Node 20 types.
test_framework: vitest 1.6.1 in watcher only (one suite: watcher/src/roomMap.test.ts, 27 tests). web has NO unit runner — tsc is its type gate.
build_command: web: `cd web && npm run build` (runs `tsc && vite build`). watcher: no separate build (tsx).
test_command: watcher: `cd watcher && npm test` (vitest run). web: none — `cd web && npm run build` is the type+bundle gate.
verification_instructions: V1 (design §8): `cd watcher && npm test` passes (existing 27 + new tool_result cases). V2: `cd web && npm run build` type-checks and bundles cleanly. V3: manual against real/replayed logs — paired rows show the outcome, blocks summarize+collapse, filters+search persist and re-apply live, the guide collapses/reopens, the log reads well at 360px. Clean up any scratch files before finishing.
environment_constraints: Local-only app; no deployment is in scope (user decided against Vercel). Ports: web 5280, watcher WebSocket 8787. Baseline confirmed green before planning: watcher 27 tests pass, web build clean. Do not reintroduce the removed header stat counts. Multi-session multi-employee visualization is out of scope.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/steering files in the repo. Hard invariant S1: ALL log-derived strings render via element.textContent or document.createTextNode ONLY — never innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, eval, or new Function. Palette rule: the signature green (CSS var --green) is reserved strictly for LIVE / active-room / character; it must NOT be used for active filter chips or success rows. Watcher continues sanitize()->redact()->truncate before any string reaches the web.
key_patterns: Watcher parser.ts normalizes one raw messages.jsonl line into an ActivityEvent; sanitize(input,max), redact(text), normalizeTs are its safety helpers; labelFor() and kindFor() switch on payload.type; tool name is set only for tool_call today. index.ts ingest() already pairs tags across call/result via a callTags Map (tool_call sets callTags[callId]=tag; tool_result reads+deletes it; 500-cap FIFO). Web main.ts is module-scoped vars + a WebSocket feed; existing reusable helpers: LEGEND_SWATCH (Partial<Record<RoomId,string>>, keyed by RAW watcher ids incl 'po', no 'founder'), ROOM_ICON, relativeTime(ts), ROOMS[id].label, resolveRoom(id) from rooms.ts (aliases po->founder then validates). addActivity() renders flat rows and caps DOM at 200; applyBubble() drives the 3D speech bubble + header status AND currently injects synthetic log lines via logBubble() (to be removed). react() does confetti/oops on tool_result tags.
